address_normalization: Trim surrounding whitespace and compare email addresses case-insensitively.
household_rule: Send at most one invitation per normalized email address in a campaign. When eligible records share an address, use the earliest resolved ticket as the participant record and include all covered ticket IDs only in the internal completion summary.
participant_rule: Reuse an existing live participant for the same normalized address. Add one participant only when no live match exists.
delivery_rule: Skip any normalized address already present for CXSAT-W37 in campaign_delivery_history.csv.
subject: Your recent support experience - CXSAT-W37
body_template: Your recent support case was resolved this week. We invite you to share feedback in survey 374812 using participant token {{participant_token}}. Please submit one response for this invitation. Thank you, Customer Experience Team.
